templates.name: Platform Statement Hero
templates.intent: State Monarchic's autonomous engineering platform direction while making the current commercial surface obvious.
layoutRules: Keep the hero and the adjacent proof or status panel visible in the first desktop viewport.
Use direct product nouns before abstract platform language.
Keep the brutalist black, white, border-led visual system intact.
antiPatterns: Do not make the page read like a generic AI agency landing page.
Do not imply the full autonomous platform is generally available when the MCP catalog is the current surface.

templates.name: Metric Proof Grid
templates.intent: Present benchmark or operational proof points with scope and caveats close to the numbers.
layoutRules: Pair each metric with the dataset, environment, or route that produced it.
Separate local benchmark quality from hosted infrastructure latency.
Avoid color coding that makes metrics look more certain than the source supports.
antiPatterns: Do not mix unrelated benchmark harnesses in one unlabeled ranking.
Do not hide limitations below the fold when the metric is used as sales proof.

templates.name: Product Catalog Matrix
templates.intent: Help buyers compare MCP products, bundles, availability, and waitlist state.
layoutRules: Group usage tiers, available MCPs, bundles, and coming-soon products clearly.
Make ExplicitMem, RepoIntel, and BrowserOps easy to compare without tab switching.
Show prices only when the generated Stripe catalog exposes the plan as available.
Keep waitlist or access state visible on every product path that cannot be purchased.
antiPatterns: Do not bury the Monarchic AI platform direction under individual MCP cards.
Do not invent prices or checkout promises outside pricing.generated.json.

templates.name: Evidence Cards
templates.intent: Summarize research pages with the metric, product connection, and evidence boundary visible.
layoutRules: Show product and research links together.
Keep the scope note on the same page as the benchmark summaries.
Use cards only for repeated research items.
antiPatterns: Do not present benchmark cards as universal product claims.
Do not use tabbed navigation for unrelated product and research destinations.

templates.name: Benchmark Report
templates.intent: Document one product benchmark with methodology, result tables, and limits.
layoutRules: Put the headline result before the detailed table.
Keep methodology and environment data explicit enough for a release reviewer.
Link back to the product page after the evidence is established.
antiPatterns: Do not use unverifiable adjectives in place of method details.
Do not compare products without naming the benchmark source and measurement type.

templates.name: Waitlist Conversion Form
templates.intent: Collect qualified interest while being clear that access is gated.
layoutRules: The form must have an obvious submitted state.
Explain what happens after joining without promising immediate access.
Keep the form reachable from homepage, catalog, and coming-soon product surfaces.
antiPatterns: Do not make a no-op CTA.
Do not request more personal data than the workflow uses.

templates.name: Product Proof Detail
templates.intent: Connect a product's buyer fit, capability, research evidence, and availability state.
layoutRules: Lead with what the product does, then show proof and availability.
Keep research links near the claims they substantiate.
Make coming-soon products feel intentionally gated rather than broken.
antiPatterns: Do not reuse the same generic product copy across MCPs.
Do not let dynamic catalog cards obscure product-specific evidence.

templates.name: MCP Quickstart Guide
templates.intent: Explain how a gated account holder connects Monarchic MCP routes to an MCP-aware client without implying public self-serve access.
layoutRules: Show prerequisites before configuration snippets.
State that Monarchic MCP capability runs on hosted infrastructure while client packages are lightweight adapters.
Position S3 as supporting artifact storage, not the primary public install path.
Use placeholders for credentials and dashboard-provided URLs.
Keep validation and limitations close to setup instructions.
antiPatterns: Do not publish private API URLs or secret names.
Do not add public website download buttons for MCP server binaries.
Do not imply instant access from the public website.
Do not present client snippets as active until account access is granted.
